title: [ingest] CI uses roots-read-only directory if it exists; local dev uses roots/
summary: tests/conftest.py sets `_ROOTS_DIR` to `tests/roots-read-only` when `'CI' in os.environ` AND that directory exists; otherwise falls back to `tests/roots`. This means test root fixtures may be in different directories between CI and local runs. Developers adding new test roots must add them to both directories or CI tests will fail.
